_comment: Car UI settings. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Anything left out uses the built-in default.
_password: Leave empty: the password is read from server_config (server.py's config), so it's only set in one place. The web page itself has no password.
_car_listen: The Pi connects here: set the Pi's server.port to this port.
_server: Where server.py runs (normally this same laptop).
_web: The web page: http://localhost:8080 here, http://<laptop-ip>:8080 from a phone on the same network.
_start_mode: auto, hold or manual. hold = the car never moves until you choose otherwise on the page.
_manual_timeout_s: Manual mode: if the page sends nothing for this long, the car is stopped.
_dirs: Relative paths are inside the ui/ folder.
